$comment: EXPERIMENTAL — declarative mapping from the canonical Part I instance-data model to UBL QualificationApplicationRequest XML. This is data, not code: each rule connects a source path in the instance JSON to a target element path in the UBL tree. A small interpreter (map.mjs) walks these rules to build the XML. Kept deliberately separate from both the instance model and the form definition.

rules.$comment: PI03 — procedure type (bare code) → ProcedureCode with listID
PI02 — contracting authority official name → ContractingParty/Party/PartyName/Name
PI02 — contracting authority identifier value → PartyIdentification/ID, scheme → schemeID attribute
PI02 — country (bare code) → PostalAddress/Country/IdentificationCode with listID

PI01 — publication reference. A single typed reference maps to one cac:AdditionalDocumentReference. Notice identifier and URL are two facets of the same reference (they map together, not as alternatives).
DocumentTypeCode is mandatory (Schematron BR-COM-10-03) and, as a code, requires listID/listAgencyID/listVersionID (BR-OTH-01).
Optional notice URL, nested inside the same AdditionalDocumentReference.
